summary: RPC is a financially robust, family-controlled oilfield services company whose 25% drawdown reflects industry-cycle pressure-pumping/pricing weakness, not concealed distress. Balance sheet is a fortress: $212M cash, zero debt, $83M unused revolver, $1.03B equity. Auditor (Grant Thornton) issued a clean unqualified opinion on both financials and ICFR. The Rollins-controlled board sustained the dividend and repurchased 1M shares in Q1 2024 during the drawdown — a costly confidence signal inconsistent with a distress-concealment story. Q1 2024 revenue -20.7% YoY and pressure pumping -33% YoY are honestly disclosed with the rig-count benchmark. The framework's signal here is the ABSENCE of forensic red flags — no going-concern, no covenant amendment, no restructuring, no insider self-dealing, no auditor change, no impairment. The two modest Mode-B findings (customer-concentration framing softened in 2023; underlying op-income decline -70% once pension settlement is removed) are honestly visible in the filings. Verdict: LONG-tier (honest cyclical, not a liar).
